sermon.title: The army of God - November 6, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Revelation shows kings giving their power to the beast, but the Lamb overcomes and has given us authority. The battle is now; praise, prayer and discipline are weapons. Joel 2’s great army marches in rank, brings the fear of God and leaps obstacles—enlist.
